name: R064-chansey-metronome-transform-ends-encore
why: Challenge 1. The player's Chansey 227 calls Metronome 14 turns (slot 0); the foe is Minun 187 (Spark, Charm, Encore, Helping Hand; Spark does about 7% of Chansey's HP). The game's Encore keeps the Metronome slot (Metronome is the last move used: battle_script_commands.c:4407); while it holds, a Metronome call of Transform replaces slot 0 and the Encore ends silently at the next end-of-turn check (battle_util.c:1724). Chance per seed about 1%.
